name: List All Payables
description: Returns all payable bills that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: page[number]
queryFilters.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1.

queryFilters.name: page[size]
queryFilters.description: Page size for pagination. Default is 1000.

responseFields.name: data[].TotalAmount
responseFields.description: The total amount of the payable. Ensure that the total amount is equal to the total of all line items summed.

responseFields.name: data[].BankAccountId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the bank account associated with the payable

responseFields.name: data[].CheckNumber
responseFields.description: The check number of the payable

responseFields.name: data[].CreatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the payable was created

responseFields.name: data[].LineItems
responseFields.description: Array of line item attributes present on the payable(s)

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount due for the line item

attributes.name: BillId
attributes.description: The bill ID relevant to the line item

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: A brief description of the line item

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: The property ID relevant to the line item

attributes.name: PropertyName
attributes.description: The property name relevant to the line item

responseFields.name: data[].VendorId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the vendor owed the payable

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
